Answer: C
Reason: The lateral view (Figure 2b) reveals bowel gas patterns and soft tissue density within the posterior thoracic cavity, which is characteristic of abdominal contents herniating through a diaphragmatic defect (Bochdalek hernia) rather than true pulmonary consolidation or simple pleural fluid. This anatomical anomaly mimics the appearance of lower lobe consolidation and effusion on the frontal radiograph.
